findingDetails.title: The .skilled/release/ prefix skip blanks an entire namespace, hiding wrong filenames inside it
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: confirmed the source tree holds only .gitignore under .skilled/release/ so the skip fixes a real false positive; confirmed no other warning code covers these paths
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The namespace is engine-owned and unverifiable from the source tree by construction; a validator warning was never the right instrument there
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A release-state filename drift later observed that this skip hid raises it

findingDetails.title: Dangling symlinks are accepted by the backtick check but rejected by the link check
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: checked severity split is deliberate (links fail-closed, backticks advisory); no current corpus citation triggers the asymmetry; existing dangling symlinks have no checkable extensions
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The two scanners may intentionally differ because only links are meant to be fail-closed; if so the difference belongs in the comment as stated policy
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A comment declaring the deliberate difference, or pathChecks adopting pathPresent; a playbook citing a build-output symlink as a link raises impact
